categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Touches `src/index/base.{cpp,h}` and all concrete index implementations (`txindex`, `blockfilterindex`, `txospenderindex`, `coinstatsindex`) to batch database writes and update synchronization logic.
categories.rationale: Batches LevelDB index writes into 500-block windows and retrieves block ranges under a single cs_main lock acquisition, significantly reducing I/O and lock contention during initial index synchronization. The author notes this 'improves sync time on HDD due to the reduced number of disk write operations' and reduces cs_main contention to improve responsiveness during initial sync, while also laying groundwork for parallel index sync (#26966).

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches only `src/index/` and index tests; does not modify validation, chainstate, or consensus code.
categories.rationale: The PR modifies only the optional index framework and implementations under `src/index/`. Although it holds the `UTXO Db and Indexes` label, the category definition specifies that label is only a prior for validation when changes touch the coins database rather than `src/index/`.
